questions.prompt: Without looking: explain constant-growth dividend valuation and one mistake to avoid.
questions.explanation: The Gordon model discounts a perpetual dividend stream growing at a constant rate. Required return must exceed growth, and the numerator is next period’s dividend. Watch for: Do not use the just-paid dividend without growing it once.

D₁: next dividend; r: equity required return; g: perpetual growth

formula.name: Gordon growth value
formula.expression: V₀ = D₁ / (r − g), with r > g
formula.variables: D₁: next dividend; r: equity required return; g: perpetual growth
formula.intuition: Value a stable perpetual dividend stream.
formula.when: Value a stable perpetual dividend stream.
formula.mistake: The model is invalid with g ≥ r.
